title: fix(doctor): stop repeated warnings for archived Workshop backups
body:
Closes #161441

Related: #161549

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes repeated Doctor warnings after a legacy Skill Workshop backup has a complete history-only archive and its original workspace is no longer configured.

## User Impact

Operators can retire the old workspace mapping without recurring backup-migration warnings. Original backups remain retained, and incomplete, changed, or aliased archives remain visible for review. No configuration, CLI, dependency, or stored-format change is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The collection-backup migration owner now verifies completed archives across configured agent backup locations before resolving current workspace ownership. Verification covers the matching history-only manifest and the entire saved workspace, including metadata, empty directories, large files, and copied links. The archive root must be an independent directory; it cannot merely point back to the source. Pending backups still use the existing whole-root workspace-ambiguity and migration checks.

## Evidence

- The retired-workspace regression fails on the original code with `no verified owner` after successful archival. Negative controls also exposed mixed-workspace filtering, bounded tree hashing, copied-link rejection, and source/parent archive aliases before their corrections.
- `pnpm test src/commands/doctor-skill-workshop-collection-backups.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **24/24 passed three times** on Linux/Node 24.19.0. Measured command wall times: **47.31 s, 42.61 s, 41.51 s**; reported test execution was approximately 20–23 s per run. Hosted CI timing is pending.
- Direct-import discovery selects that existing owner suite. The rehearsal and update-inventory siblings also passed: **24/24 tests**, 33.54 s wrapper wall time.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`: passed, including core types, all 27 test-type graphs, lint, formatting, and static guards.
- Built and checked the candidate package. Published **openclaw@2026.9.6** first reproduced the warning, then its unmodified updater installed the exact candidate tarball successfully. Candidate build metadata matched the tarball. Two subsequent real `doctor --fix --non-interactive --no-workspace-suggestions` runs emitted no legacy-backup warning; original source and archive contents, including link targets, remained unchanged. All state, configuration, HOME, and the port were isolated.
- Fresh independent Codex review at **P1**: scoped-clean, with no accepted/actionable P0 or P1 findings.

The final Testbox command exited 0. One earlier runner was cancelled and replaced; its interrupted run is not counted as passing evidence. Local negative-control wall time was dominated by shared compiler preparation, not slow test execution. No unexpected test flake was observed.

Change size: production **+86/-24**, tests **+177/-38**, documentation **+6/-0**. No changelog edit; release-note context is captured above.

## Credit

Thanks @sunlit-deng, whose earlier #161549 identified the same convergence problem and covered changed-content verification; this PR additionally rejects aliased parents, keeps mixed-root ambiguity detection, and avoids the skill-evaluation size limits for archive verification.
